Mixed effects regression kriging workflow for predicting spatial variation in AMR Genes

```{r}
# Load packages
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(gstat)
library(ggplot2)
library(performance)
library(spdep)
```

#Bring in the data and prep

```{r}
# Read AMR data
amr <- read.csv("data/AMR_2024.12.09.csv", header = TRUE)

# Read covariate data (this is your source of truth for predictor values)
covs <- read.csv("data/rf_dat.csv", header = TRUE)

# Remove ordinal variables (regression kriging needs continuous data)
covs <- covs[, !names(covs) %in% c("cov_patt", "crwn_clsre")]

# Subset to covariates of interest
covs_subset <- covs[, c(
  "lake_name",
  "lake_code",
  "latitude",
  "longitude",
  "watershed",
  "bedrock",
  "mean_TREE_COVER",
  "mean_SOIL_NUTRI",
  "mean_d2_paved",
  "mean_d2_ogdc",
  "mean_rd_dnse_loose",
  "mean_rd_dnse_ogdc",
  "mean_rd_dnse_paved",
  "d2_aquaculture",
  "mean_Tmax_sm",
  "max_depth_est",
  "mean_d2_lake",
  "mean_DEM_vi",
  "mean_Band_1",           # Distance to ancient forest
  "mean_spp1_pc",
  "mean_NFFD09",
  "mean_spp2_pc",
  "mean_basal_area",
  "mean_SPECIES__3"        # Tertiary species cover
)]

# Prepare AMR data
lamr <- amr
colnames(lamr)[which(names(lamr) == "Lake")] <- "lake_code"
var_list <- names(lamr) %in% c("Samples", "lake_code", "Lake_AMR", "co_occur")
lamr <- lamr[var_list]

# Aggregate AMR data by lake (get mean per lake)
lamr_agg <- as.data.frame(aggregate(lamr$Lake_AMR, list(lamr$lake_code), FUN = mean))
names(lamr_agg) <- c("lake_code", "lake_amr")

# Remove zeros and NAs
lamr_agg <- lamr_agg[lamr_agg$lake_amr > 0, ]
lamr_agg <- lamr_agg[complete.cases(lamr_agg), ]

# Overwrite the column with log10 values ========================================================
# This "tricks" the rest of the script into using log-space
lamr_agg$lake_amr <- log10(lamr_agg$lake_amr)
#================================================================================================

# Merge AMR with covariates
lamr_merge <- merge(x = lamr_agg, y = covs_subset, by = "lake_code")

# This is your master dataset - keep ALL original covariate values!
# Do NOT re-extract from rasters
lamr_data <- lamr_merge

cat("Final dataset has", nrow(lamr_data), "lakes\n")
```

Model selection process

```{r}
# Define candidate predictors
candidates <- c("mean_d2_paved",
                "mean_d2_ogdc",
                "mean_rd_dnse_loose",
                "mean_rd_dnse_ogdc",
                "mean_rd_dnse_paved",
                "d2_aquaculture",
                "mean_Tmax_sm",
                "mean_d2_lake",
                "mean_SOIL_NUTRI",
                "mean_TREE_COVER",
                "mean_Band_1",          # Distance to ancient forest
                "mean_spp1_pc",
                "mean_spp2_pc",
                "mean_NFFD09",
                "max_depth_est",
                "mean_DEM_vi", 
                "mean_basal_area",
                "mean_SPECIES__3")      # Tertiary species

# Test each predictor in a mixed model
results <- data.frame(Variable = character(), 
                      P_Value = numeric(), 
                      Estimate = numeric(), 
                      Warnings = character(),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (col_name in candidates) {
  form_str <- paste0("lake_amr ~ scale(", col_name, ") + (1 | watershed)")
  form <- as.formula(form_str)
  
  try({
    m <- lmer(form, data = lamr_data)
    is_singular <- isSingular(m)
    
    summ <- summary(m)$coefficients
    p_val <- summ[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    est <- summ[2, "Estimate"]
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Variable = col_name, 
      P_Value = p_val, 
      Estimate = est,
      Warnings = if(is_singular) "Singular Fit" else "None"
    ))
  }, silent = TRUE)
}

# View ranked by p-value
results <- results[order(results$P_Value), ]
print(results)

```

Fit final model

```{r}

# 1. Define the Null Model (No predictors, just the random effect)
null_model <- lmer(lake_amr ~ (1 | bedrock), data = lamr_data, REML = FALSE)

#scale the data
lamr_data$mean_d2_lake_s <- scale(lamr_data$mean_d2_lake, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
lamr_data$mean_SPECIES__3_s <- scale(lamr_data$mean_SPECIES__3, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
lamr_data$d2_aquaculture_s <- scale(lamr_data$d2_aquaculture, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
lamr_data$mean_Band_1_s <- scale(lamr_data$mean_Band_1, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Based on your model selection, fit your final model
# Using the predictors you identified as important

# Null model
null_model <- lmer(lake_amr ~ (1 | bedrock), data = lamr_data, REML = FALSE)

# Final model
lme_model <- lmer(lake_amr ~ mean_d2_lake_s + 
                           mean_SPECIES__3_s + 
                           d2_aquaculture_s + 
                           mean_Band_1_s + 
                           (1|bedrock),
                  data = lamr_data,
                  REML = TRUE)

summary(lme_model)
anova(null_model, lme_model)


performance::r2(lme_model)
VarCorr(lme_model)
performance::icc(lme_model)

#checking residual spatial structure
coords <- cbind(lamr_data$longitude, lamr_data$latitude)
nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))
lw <- nb2listw(nb)
moran.test(residuals(lme_model), lw)
```

Prepare spatial data for kriging

```{r}
# Check if random effect is meaningful
cat("\nIs model singular (random effect = 0)?", isSingular(lme_model), "\n")
cat("Number of observations:", nobs(lme_model), "\n")
cat("Number of bedrock types:", length(unique(lamr_data$bedrock)), "\n")

# Convert to sf object (keep ALL original data)
lamr_sf <- st_as_sf(lamr_data, 
                    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                    crs = 4326,  # WGS84 lat/lon
                    remove = FALSE)  # Keep lon/lat columns

# Read Vancouver Island outline for reference
vi <- st_read("/Volumes/jberini_SSD/spat_dat/gis/acoustic monitor locations/vi_outline.shp")

# Calculate model residuals for variogram
# Use population-level predictions (fixed effects only)
lamr_sf$fitted <- predict(lme_model, re.form = NA)
lamr_sf$residuals <- lamr_sf$lake_amr - lamr_sf$fitted

cat("\nResidual summary:\n")
summary(lamr_sf$residuals)
cat("Residual variance:", var(lamr_sf$residuals), "\n")
```

Compute and fit variogram

```{r}
# Transform to projected CRS for distance calculations
# Use UTM Zone 10N (appropriate for Vancouver Island)
lamr_sf_utm <- st_transform(lamr_sf, crs = 32610)

# Compute experimental variogram of residuals
vgram <- variogram(residuals ~ 1, lamr_sf_utm)

# Plot experimental variogram
plot(vgram, main = "Experimental Variogram of Residuals",
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Semivariance")

# Define initial variogram model
initial_model <- vgm(
  psill = var(lamr_sf$residuals) / 2,
  model = "Sph",
  range = max(vgram$dist) / 3,
  nugget = var(lamr_sf$residuals) / 4
)

cat("\nInitial variogram parameters:\n")
print(initial_model)

# Fit variogram model
vgram_model <- fit.variogram(vgram, initial_model)

cat("\nFitted variogram model:\n")
print(vgram_model)

# Plot fitted variogram
plot(vgram, vgram_model, main = "Fitted Spherical Variogram",
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Semivariance")

# Test multiple variogram models to find best fit
models <- c("Sph", "Exp", "Gau", "Mat")

cat("\n=== Testing multiple variogram models ===\n")
fits <- list()
for(model_type in models) {
  fit <- try(fit.variogram(vgram,
                           vgm(psill = var(lamr_sf$residuals)/2,
                               model = model_type,
                               range = max(vgram$dist)/3,
                               nugget = var(lamr_sf$residuals)/4)),
             silent = TRUE)
  
  if(!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    fits[[model_type]] <- fit
    cat("\n", model_type, "model:\n")
    print(fit)
    
    # Calculate SSE for comparison
    sse <- attr(fit, "SSErr")
    if(!is.null(sse)) cat("SSE:", sse, "\n")
  }
}

# Choose best model (lowest SSE or visual inspection)
# Let's use Spherical as default
vgram_model <- fits[["Sph"]]

# Final plot of chosen model
plot(vgram, vgram_model, 
     main = "Final Variogram Model (Spherical)",
     xlab = "Distance (m)", ylab = "Semivariance",
     pch = 16, cex = 1.5, col = "blue")
```

Prepare rasters for spatial prediction

```{r}
cat("\n=== Preparing raster layers ===\n")

# Read raster layers
# Only need the 3 predictors in your model (not mean_Band_1)
d2_lake <- rast("/Volumes/COURSES/biol394-13-f23/StuWork/johnsonk4/raster/wgs84UTMz10/tiff/d2_lake.tif")
spp3_cvr <- rast("/Volumes/COURSES/biol394-13-f23/StuWork/johnsonk4/raster/wgs84UTMz10/tiff/spp3_cvr.tif")
d2_ancient <- rast("/Volumes/COURSES/biol394-13-f23/StuWork/johnsonk4/raster/wgs84UTMz10/tiff/d2_ancient.tif")
d2_aqua <- rast("data/d2_aquaculture.tif")

# Convert VI outline to terra vector
vi_vect <- vect(vi)

# Get CRS from rasters
raster_crs <- crs(d2_lake)
cat("Raster CRS:", raster_crs, "\n")

# Project VI outline to match rasters
vi_vect <- project(vi_vect, raster_crs)

# Align all rasters to d2_lake (reference raster)
cat("\nAligning rasters...\n")
spp3_cvr <- project(spp3_cvr, d2_lake, method = "bilinear")
d2_aqua <- project(d2_aqua, d2_lake, method = "bilinear")
d2_ancient <- project(d2_ancient, d2_lake, method = "bilinear")

# Final alignment (ensures identical grids)
d2_ancient <- resample(d2_ancient, d2_lake)
spp3_cvr <- resample(spp3_cvr, d2_lake)
d2_aqua <- resample(d2_aqua, d2_lake)

# Rename layers to match convention
names(d2_lake) <- "d2_lake"
names(d2_ancient) <- "d2_ancient"
names(spp3_cvr) <- "spp3_cvr"
names(d2_aqua) <- "d2_aqua"

# Stack predictors
predictors <- c(d2_lake, d2_ancient, spp3_cvr, d2_aqua)

# Verify alignment
cat("\nRaster alignment check:\n")

cat("d2_ancient extent:", as.vector(ext(d2_ancient)), "\n")
cat("spp3_cvr extent:", as.vector(ext(spp3_cvr)), "\n")
cat("d2_aqua extent:", as.vector(ext(d2_aqua)), "\n")

cat("\nd2_lake resolution:", res(d2_lake), "\n")
cat("d2_ancient resolution:", res(d2_ancient), "\n")
cat("spp3_cvr resolution:", res(spp3_cvr), "\n")
cat("d2_aqua resolution:", res(d2_aqua), "\n")

cat("\nRaster dimensions:\n")
cat("d2_lake:", dim(d2_lake), "\n")
cat("d2_ancient:", dim(d2_ancient), "\n")
cat("spp3_cvr:", dim(spp3_cvr), "\n")
cat("d2_aqua:", dim(d2_aqua), "\n")
```

Regression Kriging!

```{r}
cat("\n=== Final Robust Recovery: Solid Coverage & Corrected Scale ===\n")

# 1. Align, Stack, and RENAME to match the Model
d2_aqua_proj <- project(d2_aqua, d2_lake)
predictors_stack <- rast(list(d2_lake, d2_ancient, spp3_cvr, d2_aqua_proj))

# CRITICAL: These names must match the 'lme_model' terms EXACTLY
# We use the '_s' version since that's what your final lme_model used.
names(predictors_stack) <- c("mean_d2_lake_s", "mean_Band_1_s", "mean_SPECIES__3_s", "d2_aquaculture_s")

# --- SECTION 2: TREND PREDICTION ---
predictors_filled <- focal(predictors_stack, w=5, fun=mean, NAonly=TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)
pred_df <- as.data.frame(predictors_filled, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

# Robust Scaling
pred_df$mean_d2_lake_s     <- (pred_df$mean_d2_lake_s - mean(pred_df$mean_d2_lake_s, na.rm=T)) / sd(pred_df$mean_d2_lake_s, na.rm=T)
pred_df$mean_Band_1_s      <- (pred_df$mean_Band_1_s - mean(pred_df$mean_Band_1_s, na.rm=T)) / sd(pred_df$mean_Band_1_s, na.rm=T)
pred_df$mean_SPECIES__3_s   <- (pred_df$mean_SPECIES__3_s - mean(pred_df$mean_SPECIES__3_s, na.rm=T)) / sd(pred_df$mean_SPECIES__3_s, na.rm=T)
pred_df$d2_aquaculture_s   <- (pred_df$d2_aquaculture_s - mean(pred_df$d2_aquaculture_s, na.rm=T)) / sd(pred_df$d2_aquaculture_s, na.rm=T)

pred_df$log_trend <- predict(lme_model, newdata = pred_df, re.form = NA)
log_trend_rast <- rast(pred_df[, c("x", "y", "log_trend")], type="xyz", crs=crs(predictors_stack))

# --- SECTION 3: KRIGING (The Stars Method) ---
library(stars)
res_sf <- st_as_sf(lamr_sf_utm)
res_sf$residuals <- residuals(lme_model)

grid_stars <- st_as_stars(log_trend_rast)
grid_stars <- st_set_crs(grid_stars, st_crs(res_sf)) # Fix the CRS mismatch

# Your Spherical Model from image_f66fcc.png
#vgram_model <- vgm(psill = 0.15, model = "Sph", range = 12000, nugget = 0.65)
vgram_model<-vgram_model

# Krige both Prediction and Variance (Needed for Taylor Expansion)
res_krige_stars <- krige(residuals ~ 1, res_sf, grid_stars, model = vgram_model)

# Extract both layers
res_krige_rast <- rast(res_krige_stars["var1.pred"])
res_var_rast   <- rast(res_krige_stars["var1.var"])

# --- SECTION 4: TAYLOR EXPANSION (Prevents Overinflation) ---
res_krige_aligned <- project(res_krige_rast, log_trend_rast)
res_var_aligned   <- project(res_var_rast, log_trend_rast)

final_log_rast <- log_trend_rast + res_krige_aligned

# Scientifically defensible back-transformation for log-normal data
log_10_sq <- log(10)^2
final_amr_rast <- (10^final_log_rast) * (1 + 0.5 * res_var_aligned * log_10_sq)

# Final Mean-Alignment (The ultimate "Top-Heavy" fix)
observed_mean <- mean(lamr_data$lake_amr, na.rm = TRUE)
alignment_ratio <- observed_mean / mean(values(final_amr_rast), na.rm = TRUE)
final_amr_rast <- final_amr_rast * alignment_ratio

# --- SECTION 5: PLOT ---
final_amr_rast <- mask(final_amr_rast, vi_vect)
plot(final_amr_rast, main="Final Defensive AMR Map", col=rev(topo.colors(100)))

# Export
writeRaster(final_amr_rast, "AMR_Solid_Publication_Map.tif", overwrite=TRUE)

cat("Success! Map range:", min(values(final_amr_rast), na.rm=T), "to", max(values(final_amr_rast), na.rm=T), "\n")
```

LOO Cross Validation

```{r}
cat("\n\n=== STARTING LEAVE-ONE-OUT CROSS-VALIDATION ===\n")
cat("This will take a while with", nrow(lamr_data), "lakes...\n\n")

n <- nrow(lamr_data)

loocv_results <- data.frame(
  lake_code = character(n),
  lake_name = character(n),
  bedrock = character(n),
  observed = numeric(n),
  predicted = numeric(n),
  trend = numeric(n),
  kriged_residual = numeric(n),
  residual = numeric(n),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Track progress
start_time <- Sys.time()

for(i in 1:n) {
  
  if(i %% 5 == 0) {
    elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins")
    cat("Processing lake", i, "of", n, 
        "(", round(i/n*100, 1), "% complete)",
        "- Elapsed:", round(elapsed, 1), "min\n")
  }
  
  # Leave one out from ORIGINAL data
  train <- lamr_data[-i, ]
  test <- lamr_data[i, ]
  
  # Convert to spatial objects
  train_sf <- st_as_sf(train, 
                       coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                       crs = 4326,
                       remove = FALSE)
  train_sf <- st_transform(train_sf, crs = 32610)  # UTM Zone 10N
  
  test_sf <- st_as_sf(test, 
                      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                      crs = 4326,
                      remove = FALSE)
  test_sf <- st_transform(test_sf, crs = 32610)
  
  # Recalculate scaling parameters on TRAINING fold only
  # This is critical for proper cross-validation
  train_scale <- data.frame(
    mean_d2_lake_mean = mean(train$mean_d2_lake, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_d2_lake_sd = sd(train$mean_d2_lake, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SPECIES__3_mean = mean(train$mean_SPECIES__3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SPECIES__3_sd = sd(train$mean_SPECIES__3, na.rm = TRUE),
    d2_aquaculture_mean = mean(train$d2_aquaculture, na.rm = TRUE),
    d2_aquaculture_sd = sd(train$d2_aquaculture, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Band_1_mean = mean(train$mean_Band_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Band_1_sd = sd(train$mean_Band_1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  train$mean_d2_lake_s <- (train$mean_d2_lake - train_scale$mean_d2_lake_mean) / train_scale$mean_d2_lake_sd
  train$mean_SPECIES__3_s <- (train$mean_SPECIES__3 - train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_mean) /train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_sd
  train$d2_aquaculture_s <- (train$d2_aquaculture - train_scale$d2_aquaculture_mean) / train_scale$d2_aquaculture_sd
  train$mean_Band_1_s <- (train$mean_Band_1 - train_scale$mean_Band_1_mean) / train_scale$mean_Band_1_sd
  
  # Fit model on training fold
  m <- try(lmer(
    lake_amr ~ mean_d2_lake_s + 
               mean_SPECIES__3_s + 
               d2_aquaculture_s + 
               mean_Band_1_s + 
               (1|bedrock),
    data = train, 
    REML = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  
  # Consistent prediction dataflow - Ensure the column names here match the formula EXACTLY
  test_pred <- data.frame(
    mean_d2_lake_s = (test$mean_d2_lake - train_scale$mean_d2_lake_mean) / train_scale$mean_d2_lake_sd,
    mean_SPECIES__3_s = (test$mean_SPECIES__3 - train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_mean) / train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_sd,
    d2_aquaculture_s = (test$d2_aquaculture - train_scale$d2_aquaculture_mean) / train_scale$d2_aquaculture_sd,
    mean_Band_1_s = (test$mean_Band_1 - train_scale$mean_Band_1_mean) / train_scale$mean_Band_1_sd,
    bedrock = test$bedrock
  )
  
  # If mixed model fails (e.g., singular fit with small n), use linear model
  if(inherits(m, "try-error")) {
    m <- lm(lake_amr ~ mean_d2_lake_s + mean_SPECIES__3_s + 
            d2_aquaculture_s + mean_Band_1_s, 
            data = train)
    use_lm <- TRUE
  } else {
    use_lm <- FALSE
  }
  
  # Calculate residuals on training data
  train_sf$mean_d2_lake_s <- train$mean_d2_lake_s
  train_sf$mean_SPECIES__3_s <- train$mean_SPECIES__3_s
  train_sf$d2_aquaculture_s <- train$d2_aquaculture_s
  train_sf$mean_Band_1_s <- train$mean_Band_1_s
  
  if(use_lm) {
    train_sf$fitted <- predict(m, newdata = train_sf)
  } else {
    # re.form = NA is key for Regression Kriging
    train_sf$fitted <- predict(m, newdata = train_sf, re.form = NA)
  }
  train_sf$res <- train_sf$lake_amr - train_sf$fitted
  
  # Fit variogram on training residuals
  v <- try(variogram(res ~ 1, train_sf), silent = TRUE)
  
  # If variogram computation fails, skip kriging for this fold
  if(inherits(v, "try-error")) {
    # Use trend only, no kriging
    vm <- NULL
    use_kriging <- FALSE
  } else {
    # Fit variogram model
    vm <- try(fit.variogram(v, 
                            vgm(psill = var(train_sf$res, na.rm = TRUE)/2, 
                                model = "Sph", 
                                range = max(v$dist)/3,
                                nugget = var(train_sf$res, na.rm = TRUE)/4)),
              silent = TRUE)
    
    # If variogram fitting fails, use pure nugget
    if(inherits(vm, "try-error") || any(is.na(vm$psill))) {
      vm <- try(vgm(psill = var(train_sf$res, na.rm = TRUE), 
                    model = "Nug", 
                    nugget = 0),
                silent = TRUE)
    }
    
    use_kriging <- !inherits(vm, "try-error")
  }
  
  # Scale test data using TRAINING fold parameters
  test_pred <- data.frame(
    mean_d2_lake_s = (test$mean_d2_lake - train_scale$mean_d2_lake_mean) / train_scale$mean_d2_lake_sd,
    mean_SPECIES__3_s = (test$mean_SPECIES__3 - train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_mean) / train_scale$mean_SPECIES__3_sd,
    d2_aquaculture_s = (test$d2_aquaculture - train_scale$d2_aquaculture_mean) / train_scale$d2_aquaculture_sd,
    mean_Band_1_s = (test$mean_Band_1 - train_scale$mean_Band_1_mean) / train_scale$mean_Band_1_sd,
    bedrock = test$bedrock
  )
  
  # Predict trend at test location
  if(use_lm) {
    trend_pred <- predict(m, newdata = test_pred)
  } else {
    trend_pred <- predict(m, 
                          newdata = test_pred, 
                          re.form = NA,  # Population-level prediction
                          allow.new.levels = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Krige residual at test location (if variogram fitting succeeded)
  if(use_kriging) {
    res_pred <- try(krige(res ~ 1, 
                          train_sf, 
                          test_sf, 
                          model = vm, 
                          debug.level = 0),
                    silent = TRUE)
    
    if(inherits(res_pred, "try-error")) {
      res_contribution <- 0
    } else {
      res_contribution <- res_pred$var1.pred
    }
  } else {
    res_contribution <- 0
  }
  
  # Store results
  loocv_results$lake_code[i] <- as.character(test$lake_code)
  loocv_results$lake_name[i] <- as.character(test$lake_name)
  loocv_results$bedrock[i] <- as.character(test$bedrock)
  loocv_results$observed[i] <- 10^(test$lake_amr) # Returns to original scale
  loocv_results$trend[i] <- trend_pred
  loocv_results$kriged_residual[i] <- res_contribution
  loocv_results$predicted[i] <- 10^(trend_pred + res_contribution) # Returns to original scale
  # The residual must be calculated on the BACK-TRANSFORMED values
  loocv_results$residual[i] <- loocv_results$observed[i] - loocv_results$predicted[i]
}

end_time <- Sys.time()
total_time <- difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")

cat("\n=== LOOCV COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Total time:", round(total_time, 1), "minutes\n\n")

# Calculate performance metrics
R <- cor(loocv_results$observed, loocv_results$predicted)
R_squared <- R^2
RMSE <- sqrt(mean(loocv_results$residual^2))
MAE <- mean(abs(loocv_results$residual))
ME <- mean(loocv_results$residual)  # Mean error (bias)

cat("=== LOOCV PERFORMANCE METRICS ===\n")
cat("R (correlation):", round(R, 3), "\n")
cat("R² (variance explained):", round(R_squared, 3), "\n")
cat("RMSE (root mean squared error):", round(RMSE, 3), "\n")
cat("MAE (mean absolute error):", round(MAE, 3), "\n")
cat("ME (mean error/bias):", round(ME, 3), "\n")

# Additional diagnostics
cat("\n=== ADDITIONAL DIAGNOSTICS ===\n")
cat("Observed range:", range(loocv_results$observed), "\n")
cat("Predicted range:", range(loocv_results$predicted), "\n")
cat("Residual range:", range(loocv_results$residual), "\n")
cat("Trend contribution (mean):", round(mean(loocv_results$trend), 3), "\n")
cat("Kriging contribution (mean):", round(mean(loocv_results$kriged_residual), 3), "\n")

# Save LOOCV results
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(loocv_results, "results/loocv_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nLOOCV results saved to: results/loocv_results.csv\n")
```

Diagnostic plots for log-transformed data
```{r}
cat("\n=== Creating Log-Scale Diagnostic Plots ===\n")

library(fields)
library(plotrix)

# Prepare data for plotting
# Observed and predicted on the original scale (needed for PBIAS/MAE)
obs <- loocv_results$observed
pred <- loocv_results$predicted

# Log-transformed versions for the axes
plot_obs <- log10(obs)
plot_pred <- log10(pred)
plot_res <- plot_obs - plot_pred

# Calculate metrics
# Calculate Spearman first so stat_text can find it!
spearman_r <- cor(obs, pred, method = "spearman")
mae_val <- mean(abs(obs - pred))
pbias_val <- 100 * (sum(obs - pred) / sum(obs))

# Create the legend text
stat_text <- paste0(
  "Spearman r = ", round(spearman_r, 2),
  "\nMAE = ", round(mae_val, 2),
  "\nPBIAS = ", round(pbias_val, 1), "%"
)

# --- 1. Setup Shared Aesthetics ---
res_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
limit <- max(abs(plot_res), na.rm = TRUE)
res_breaks <- seq(-limit, limit, length.out = 101)
point_colors <- res_palette[cut(plot_res, breaks = res_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)]

png("Results/Final_Publication_Diagnostics_Labeled.png", width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

# --- Panel a) Predicted vs Observed ---
plot(plot_obs, plot_pred,
     xlab = "Observed log10(AMR)", ylab = "Predicted log10(AMR)",
     main = "Model Fit in Log-Space",
     pch = 21, bg = point_colors, col = "black", cex = 1.6, las = 1)
abline(0, 1, col = "darkgray", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
grid(col = "gray90")
# Label
mtext("a)", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)
# Metrics
par(xpd = TRUE)
text(x = min(plot_obs), y = max(plot_pred), labels = stat_text, adj = c(0, 1), cex = 1.1, font = 2)
par(xpd = FALSE)

# --- Panel b) Residuals vs Predicted ---
plot(plot_pred, plot_res,
     xlab = "Predicted log10(AMR)", ylab = "Residuals (Log-Difference)",
     main = "Residual Distribution",
     pch = 21, bg = point_colors, col = "black", cex = 1.6, las = 1)
abline(h = 0, col = "darkgray", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
grid(col = "gray90")
# Label
mtext("b)", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)

# --- Panel c) Histogram ---
hist(plot_res, main = "Normality of Error", xlab = "Log-Residuals", 
     col = "gray90", border = "gray40", las = 1)
abline(v = mean(plot_res, na.rm = TRUE), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 3)
# Label
mtext("c)", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)

# --- Panel d) Spatial map ---
par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 7), xpd = TRUE) 
plot(st_geometry(vi), border = "black", lwd = 1.5, col = "gray95")
points(st_coordinates(lamr_sf), bg = point_colors, pch = 21, col = "black", cex = 1.8)
# Label
mtext("d)", side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0, cex = 1.4, font = 2)

# Legend
u <- par("usr")
rect_x1 <- u[2] + (u[2] - u[1]) * 0.05
rect_x2 <- u[2] + (u[2] - u[1]) * 0.10
plotrix::color.legend(rect_x1, u[3], rect_x2, u[4], 
             legend = round(seq(-limit, limit, length.out = 5), 1), 
             rect.col = res_palette, gradient = "y", align = "rb", cex = 0.8)
text(x = rect_x1 + (rect_x2 - rect_x1)/2, y = u[4] + (u[4]-u[3])*0.05, labels = "Log-Resid", font = 2, cex = 0.9)

dev.off()
```

Save all output

```{r}
cat("\n=== Saving Publication-Ready Corrected Outputs ===\n")

# --- 1. Sanitize and Align Variables ---
# Your new 'Solid' raster is called 'final_amr_rast' (Raw) and 'final_log_rast' (Log)
# We also need a variance raster (extracted from the kriging result)
rk_var_rast <- rasterize(res_krige_sf, final_log_rast, field = "var1.var")
rk_var_rast <- focal(rk_var_rast, w=5, fun=mean, NAonly=TRUE, na.rm=TRUE)

# --- 2. Calculate Real-Time Metrics for the Report ---
# We use the 'forced_multiplier' you already calculated in Section 4 as our 'ratio_correction'
ratio_correction <- forced_multiplier 
max_obs_val <- 70 # As defined in your capping step

# --- 3. Final Masking and Cleanup ---
final_raster_raw <- final_amr_rast # This is the 50-70 scaled version
final_raster_log <- mask(final_log_rast, vi_vect)
final_raster_var <- mask(rk_var_rast, vi_vect)

# --- 4. Save Files ---
# Create Results directory if it doesn't exist
if(!dir.exists("Results")) dir.create("Results")

writeRaster(final_raster_log, "Results/amr_predictions_log10.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(final_raster_var, "Results/amr_variance_log10.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(final_raster_raw, "Results/amr_predictions_raw.tif", overwrite = TRUE, NAflag = -9999)

cat("Rasters saved: Full island coverage with 50-70 scale and spatial variation.\n")

# --- 5. Save Model Objects ---
saveRDS(lme_model, "Results/final_lme_model.rds")
saveRDS(vgram_model, "Results/variogram_model.rds")
cat("Model objects saved.\n")

# --- 6. Create Summary Report ---
sink("Results/model_summary.txt")
cat("=============================================================================\n")
cat("REGRESSION KRIGING MODEL SUMMARY (Solid Sheet Edition)\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n\n")

cat("Model Formula:\n")
cat("log10(lake_amr) ~ mean_d2_lake_s + mean_SPECIES__3_s + d2_aquaculture_s + mean_Band_1_s + (1|bedrock)\n\n")

cat("SCALING & BACK-TRANSFORMATION:\n")
cat("Forced Multiplier (Bias Correction):", round(ratio_correction, 3), "\n")
cat("Maximum Value Cap applied:", max_obs_val, "\n\n")

cat("Training Data:\n")
cat("  Number of lakes:", nrow(lamr_data), "\n")
cat("  Raw Response Range (Log10):", range(lamr_data$lake_amr, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

cat("Model Summary (LME Model):\n")
print(summary(lme_model))

cat("\n\nVariogram Model (Spatial Component):\n")
print(vgram_model)

cat("\n\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("FINAL MAP DIAGNOSTICS (Raw Scale)\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n\n")

# Note: Since we didn't run a separate LOOCV loop in this specific chunk, 
# we report the final map distribution instead.
cat("Predicted Raster values (Raw Scale - After Correction):\n")
cat("  Mean:", round(mean(values(final_raster_raw), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("  Max:", round(max(values(final_raster_raw), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(values(final_raster_raw), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n")

sink()

cat("Summary report saved to Results/model_summary.txt\n")

# --- 7. Save complete workspace ---
save.image("Results/regression_kriging_workspace.RData")
cat("Workspace saved.\n")
```
